nodes.summary: If `w ≤ w'` edgewise then `λ₂(L_w) ≤ λ₂(L_{w'})` (D. A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, draft of 2 April 2025, Corollary 6.2.2 for `k = 2`).
nodes.title: Algebraic connectivity is monotone in the weights

nodes.summary: For nonnegative weights and every vertex set `S`, `λ₂ · |S| · |V \ S| ≤ |V| · w(∂S)`; with `s = |S|/|V|` this reads `w(∂S)/|S| ≥ λ₂ (1 - s)`, hence the isoperimetric ratio satisfies `θ_G ≥ λ₂/2` (D. A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, draft of 2 April 2025, Theorem 20.1.1, stated there for unit weights).
nodes.title: Easy direction of Cheeger's inequality, eigenvalue form

nodes.summary: For nonnegative weights and every real `x` with `∑ x = 0`, `λ₂ · xᵀx ≤ xᵀ L x` (D. A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, draft of 2 April 2025, Section 3.2: the Courant–Fischer theorem, Theorem 2.0.1, gives `λ₂ = min_{x ⊥ 1} xᵀLx / xᵀx` because `1` spans an eigenvector of `λ₁ = 0`).
nodes.title: `λ₂` bounds the Rayleigh quotient on vectors orthogonal to the constants

nodes.summary: For a loopless finite multigraph with positive edge weights and at least two vertices, the second-smallest Laplacian eigenvalue is positive if and only if the multigraph is connected (D. A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, draft of 2 April 2025, Lemma 3.1.1).
nodes.title: `λ₂ > 0` exactly for connected graphs

A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, draft of 2 April 2025, Lemma 3.1.1, where the eigenvalues are written `0 = λ₁ ≤ λ₂ ≤ ⋯ ≤ λₙ`).

A. Spielman, *Spectral and Algebraic Graph Theory*, draft of 2 April 2025, Lemma 6.2.1 for `c = 1` (`G ≽ H` implies `λ_k(G) ≥ λ_k(H)` for all `k`), proved here from Weyl's inequality.
